conviction_note: A Q3 interim from a tower company whose 2026 guide was cut in March and confirmed in May and July. Revenue and EBITDAaL are tracking slightly under the consensus midpoint but inside the guide. Recurring FCF is tracking at or above the top of its 550-590m guide against a 576m consensus. Take-private talk sets a floor under the price. So I hold a near-balanced p_up of 52 on a 3.5% absolute move, and the findings sum to +0.4. Both measurements are small and agree in sign; neither has been fitted to the other.

findings.finding: Recurring FCF is tracking at or above the top of the 550-590m guide against a 576m consensus. H1 2026 RFCF was 300.1m (176.2 + 123.9, -5% YoY), and Intermonte expects Q3 at 163m against a 157m consensus (Q3 2025: 169.7m), so 9M is about 463m with a Q4 2025 comparable of 148m. Consensus implies an H2 down about 13% YoY, against Intermonte's -4% for Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026's RFCF miss (123.9m, -21.6% YoY) moved the stock -0.31% the next day, with the guide confirmed. The large moves came only on guidance cuts: -11.76% on 11 Nov 2025 and -7.54% on 20 Mar 2026.
findings.original_quote: flusso di cassa ricorrente nell'area di 160 milioni di euro (nostra stima 163 milioni di euro rispetto a consensus di 157 milioni di euro), rispetto ai 170 milioni di euro nel terzo trimestre 2025 -- recurring cash flow around EUR 160m (our estimate 163m against a 157m consensus), versus 170m in Q3 2025
findings.why_not_priced: The company page consensus still carries FY RFCF at 576m, just above the 570m guide midpoint, rather than near the top of the range. If the market had priced a top-end RFCF, consensus would sit near 590m. The yield-driven stock has moved sideways since 30 October (7.27-7.43).
findings.independence: The H1 and comparable RFCF figures are Inwit's own (Teleborsa Q1 https://www.teleborsa.it/DettaglioNews/193_2026-05-12_TLB/Inwit-primo-trimestre-in-linea-con-la-guidance-ricavi-a-264-milioni-ed-EBITDAaL-di-190-milioni.html; FY25 634m and the consensus at https://www.inwit.it/en/investors/analyst-coverage/). The Q3 estimate is one broker's.

findings.finding: Revenue and EBITDAaL are tracking slightly under the 1,070m / 770m consensus midpoint, though inside the guide. H1 revenue was 531.1m and EBITDAaL 380.8m. Extending the -2/3% YoY trend Intermonte expects to Q3 and Q4 (Q3 2025: 271.1m / 197.8m; Q4 2025: 270.6m / 197.6m) gives about 1,059m / 766m. Intermonte says its own estimates sit at the low end of the range and the consensus around the midpoint.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 and Q2 2026 both printed revenue -0.8% in line with the guide and moved -1.11% and -0.31% the next day.
findings.original_quote: La Società dovrebbe comunque restare on track per raggiungere la guidance 2026, con le nostre stime nella parte bassa del range e il consensus intorno al punto centrale. -- The company should stay on track for its 2026 guidance, with our estimates at the low end of the range and consensus around the midpoint.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus on Inwit's own page (26 Oct) still shows 1,070m / 770m, the midpoint. If the market had priced a low-end outcome, estimates would have migrated down. This lands inside the guide, so it is sized near 0.
findings.independence: The company's own Q1 and Q2 figures (Teleborsa links in already_public) and the FY25 / 9M25 bases (https://www.inwit.it/en/investors/analyst-coverage/) give the same arithmetic. Same broker document as finding 1 for the qualitative 'parte bassa' call.

findings.finding: Fastweb+Vodafone (Swisscom Q3, 5 Nov) confirmed a 12-year migration off Inwit towers from 2028, talks with Cellnex and Phoenix, and a target of a binding TIM tower JV by end-2026. Inwit replied that any valid termination requires the sites back by 31 March 2031, and the release will likely restate that dispute.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: MSA and JV news moved the stock -15.6% on 19 Mar 2026 (the JV announcement). The tribunal rejection on 19 Oct 2026 moved it -1.03%, and the Swisscom statements on 5 Nov moved it -0.82%.
findings.original_quote: "Al momento – precisa la tower company – non esiste alcun accordo tra INWIT e Fastweb+Vodafone circa la permanenza di Fastweb+Vodafone sull'infrastruttura di INWIT successivamente al 31 marzo 2031" -- 'At present there is no agreement between INWIT and Fastweb+Vodafone on Fastweb+Vodafone remaining on INWIT's infrastructure after 31 March 2031'
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the counterparty statement came out 5 Nov and the stock moved -0.82%. What remains is whether the release adds a TIM negotiation update or a litigation date, and its sign is unknown. Hence a small size.

findings.finding: Ardian (about 32%) and Oak Holdings 1 (about 39%; GIP, KKR, Vodafone) are reported to be exploring financing for a take-private bid for the roughly 24% free float. That gives a floor under results-day downside, and it accounts for the 60-day +19% run-up (the stock gained +4.46% on 9 Oct and +1.78% on 12 Oct).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The rumour days were +4.46% (9 Oct 2026) and +1.78% (12 Oct 2026). The February / March 2026 rumours did not stop the -7.5% move on the guidance cut.
findings.original_quote: non c'è attualmente un'offerta formale, né un prezzo, né una decisione definitiva (as relayed by the search snippet; page not opened, snippet_only) -- there is currently no formal offer, price or final decision
findings.why_not_priced: The rumour itself is priced in the run-up. What is not priced is the asymmetry it creates on a results day: a weak print is less likely to be sold hard when controlling holders are reported to be lining up bank financing. This is not an offer period, so the results are not noise.

baseline_tension: The findings lean faintly positive (RFCF tracking up, take-private floor), roughly matching the run-up's +19% over 60 days. The priced lean of -0.13 is only the run-up term, with no short anchor. There is nothing here for a crowded short to fuel and nothing that strongly cuts against the tape.

lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' and 'too small about the move': abs_move_pct raised from 3.0 to 3.5. The quarter is new and not pre-released, and the last two guidance events on this name moved -11.8% and -7.5%, though a reiteration is the base case
'A finding that lands inside the guide is a quarter the market was told to expect': the revenue/EBITDAaL finding moved toward 0, from -0.4 to -0.3
'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the Swisscom/Fastweb finding moved from -0.2 to -0.1, because the counterparty statement was priced on 5 Nov (-0.82%)
'In a live bid, results are noise': checked, and there is no offer period. The take-private item stays a small positioning finding and the formal offer stays in outside_window
'Your own session check': session_check now opens with the verdict amc and cites timestamps
